exact_items: - `FinalGUISpec.md` now shows a second internal navigation contradiction beyond the already-known Orchestrator-page drift (`§4.1` vs `§5.1`), and `Orchestrator_Page.md` itself is structurally incomplete because its TOC advertises a missing `UICommand IDs` section.
